title: Surreal Cinema Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal collage features a large purple moon face with flowers in its mouth exhaling colorful smoke and bubbles toward a lightning bolt. Below, a blue figure reaches upward while another lies across geometric shapes and desert dunes. In the upper left, a burning house on a screen overlooks an empty red theater.
prompt: A vibrant surreal collage scene with a large purple moon face with flowers growing from its mouth, exhaling pink teal and purple smoke and transparent bubbles toward a bright yellow lightning bolt. A blue-skinned female figure with long flowing hair reaches up from the right. In the lower half a blue figure lies across orange geometric triangles and purple shapes with scattered text fragments like 22% and 16%. The background transitions from an empty red movie theater with seats to a burning house on a screen in the top left, with desert dunes, a red no entry sign, black brush strokes, and a starry cosmic sky above.
